name: Intel Data Center GPU Flex 170
memory_bandwidth_basis: Intel ARK spec table: 16 GB GDDR6 at 384 GB/s. 128-bit bus implied by GDDR6 configuration.
notes: Alchemist (ACM-G11) data center GPU, the predecessor to Battlemage in the data center market. 16 GB GDDR6 at 384 GB/s. 75 W TDP. Supports oneAPI/SYCL/oneDNN. Verified llama.cpp SYCL backend device. The Flex Series is positioned for media streaming, cloud gaming, and AI inference at the edge. The Flex 170 is the higher-end variant; the Flex 140 is the lower-end. The Flex Series is distinct from both the Max Series (HBM, high compute) and the Arc Pro Series (workstation, GDDR6, higher clocks). For LLM inference, the Flex 170's 16 GB VRAM limits it to smaller models (7B-14B at Q4 quantization).
